page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening, with a book gutter and a sliver of the facing left page at the far left edge, which is not transcribed). One column of running text, full width; a side note number "18" in the right margin beside the line "Quarta propositio est"; a catchword "P" and the following word "pus" at the foot.

main_text.p: eft corpus Chrifti, quia certò teftetur exhi-beri nobis corpus illud, quod figurat: Vel quia Dominus vifibile illud fymbolum no-bis porrigendo, unà dat etiam nobis fuum corpus: neque enim fallax eft Chriftus, qui vacuis figuris nos ludat. Proinde illud mihi eft extra controverfiam, veritatem hîc cum fuo figno conjunctam effe, hoc eft, non minus verè nos, quantum ad vim fpiritualem attinet, participes corporis Chriffti fieri, quàm pane vefcimur. Quæ verba ultima tametfi omittunt Wirtenbergici: cum Calvino tamen, atque adeò nobifcum quoad modum loquendi confentiunt. Cum ergò de re conftet, quid opus contendere de nuda Metonymias notione & appellatione?

Quarta propofitio eft: Hoc eft corpus18 meum, Hic eft fanguis meus. Hîc jam quæritur, an fit ea ab omni tropo libera? Ita docent V Wirtembergici in refut. Orthod. conf. cap.10.pag.610. hæc verba: hoc eft corpus meum, κατα τὸ ῥητὸν explicanda effe. Idque ut obtineant, cenfent, vocabulo Hoc non demonftrari tantùm proximè antecedens, panem nempe vel poculum: fed utrumq; fimul panem & corpus Chrifti, vinum & fanguinem Chrifti: atque adeò per pronomen (Hoc) non panem tantùm, fed corpus

page.notes: Right margin note "18" is a marginal reference number. The catchword "pus" is printed at the foot right; the "P" at foot centre is a signature-style mark. The Greek phrase "κατα τὸ ῥητὸν" is as best read; the Greek is printed in the scan as "καταὶ τὸ ῥητὸν" and may carry a printing variant. Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed.
